Arrivals are actual reached job boundaries, separate from awake overlap and delivered15minutes.
Invited counts mean guests with actual received notice/reply records, not everyone who could see a noticeboard.
Later events are observed actions/completions, not inferred motives or calibrated benefit.
No new gameplay, provider/model calls, owner browser, source-unread visitor or player/taste acceptance.
nextActivityByGuest in the full report means first after checkpoint; laterByEvening and this summary use activities strictly after each evening end.
Invited means actual received invitation records, not intended audience. Arrived excludes the organiser and records observed job arrival, independent of awake delivery.
Only672 rounds occur after selected event end; additional pre-event rounds bridge the already-fixed future recurrence from the unchanged selected checkpoint.
